title: Families Drawn Together By Communication Revolution
universe: 3,014 U.S. adults, nationally representative; the figure is among those with a living parent
limits: Distance is self-reported as within an hour's drive, not a county. National only. The share of parents near an adult child quoted in earlier notes is not on this page and is not used.

nearParent.quote: Sixty-five percent of respondents in the Pew survey who have a living parent say they live within an hour’s drive of that parent.

use: SG-P15-kin-generation: the band the share of residents whose living parent lives in their county is reported against (scripts/research/people-year.ts); the builder item people-kin-placement-by-distance places relatives by it.
